data.narrative:
Shine Technologies, a Series E nuclear energy company founded by Greg Piefer, has raised over $1.0B to date. The nuclear energy sector contains nine known comparable companies—three public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and six private (including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy)—though same-stage and valuation-tier peers remain sparse.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised ($1.0B) as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. A peer-median approach was not feasible; while six nuclear energy peers exist, filtering for same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers yielded insufficient data (fewer than three datapoints required for reliable median calculation), making broad sector comparison unreliable.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median of $1.4B, derived from the single applicable method. The principal uncertainties are the sparse peer universe for calibration and the absence of disclosed recent financing rounds at comparable stages to verify step-up multiples. Any revised analysis should prioritize obtaining disclosed valuations from recent Series D and Series E closings in nuclear energy to strengthen cross-validation.
